owner: B timetable import; supplemental integration fix
cause: Closing a native file chooser emits window focus. The shared browser session hook intentionally revalidates ownership, temporarily clearing session. ConnectedImportPage previously unmounted OwnedImport, discarding selected file, pending asynchronous read, calendar and preview.
repair: Keep same-owner import mounted during revalidation, with visibility hidden, aria-hidden and disabled controls; retain layout/scroll.
Remove retained editor on authentication failure; remount for a different verified workspace.
Epoch guards stop subsequent draft/commit writes if revalidation starts during an operation.
Sticky status distinguishes reading, missing calendar, file parsed, cloud draft and committed database readback. It never equates file selection or draft creation with save success.

verification.native_focus_integration: Actual window focus event through real useBrowserSession during a deferred File.text read; same file input and resulting preview retained, no cloud writes.
verification.account_safety: Paused writes blocked; verified owner changes discard state; revoked verification removes editor; interrupted confirmation cannot proceed to commit.
verification.desktop_native_user_recording: Used as diagnosis evidence; desktop native picker itself not directly automated.

deployment.live_file_check: Real local timetable-import.json accepted; calendar confirmed locally; 10 courses and 25 meeting rows previewed. No cloud draft created or committed; current timetable remains empty for user verification.

user_requested_clear.recovery: No product recycle bin; historical confirmed draft/calendar retained, manual reimport available.
